name: God-Pharaoh
description: The ruler of Amonkhet whom Samut discovers to be the plane's destroyer.

description_citations.text: "Samut". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In a sealed chamber in Bontu's Monument Samut realizes the God-Pharaoh is the plane's destroyer.
timeline.quote: Samut realized the God-Pharaoh was not a savior, but the destroyer of the plane of Amonkhet.

citation.text: "Samut", section "The Voice of Dissent". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Revelation occurs and the Final Hours begin.
timeline.quote: Moments later, the Revelation occurred, and the Final Hours began.

citation.text: "Samut", section "Convincing Djeru". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Samut discovers the Trespasser glyph in the monument and realizes the God-Pharaoh is the Great Trespasser and the destroyer of Amonkhet.
timeline.quote: Samut realized the God-Pharaoh was not a savior but the destroyer of the plane of Amonkhet.

citation.text: "Bontu's Monument", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The benevolent God-Pharaoh is revealed to be Nicol Bolas.
timeline.quote: is actually Nicol Bolas, the malevolent dragon Planeswalker whose schemes reach far beyond this plane.

citation.text: "Amonkhet". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: In the Hour of Revelation, the God-Pharaoh's angels strip former initiates of their cartouches and the fortifying magic.
timeline.quote: the God-Pharaoh 's angels stripped former initiates of their cartouches

citation.text: "Cartouche", section "Storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The God-Pharaoh casts the plane's demons out to the Ifnir wasteland as punishment for defiance.
timeline.quote: the God-Pharaoh cast out all the plane's demons to this wasteland as punishment for daring to defy him

citation.text: "Ifnir", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

citation.text: "Amonkhet". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.
